answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the violet log reveals the live set and the cedar audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 114 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 199 aliases alive thus means 199 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ember quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
